store.summary: CC1101 Sub-GHz waterfall, PulseNet-RF & SpectrumNet-2D ML & .sub studio
store.description: RF Heatmap turns your CardputerZero with Cap CC1101 into an on-device Sub-GHz spectrum and ML lab. Sweep 315/433/868/915 MHz with an Inferno thermal waterfall, EMI room diff, and real-time SpectrumNet-2D scene/RollJam alerts; classify 28 RF protocols and 32D transmitter fingerprints with Pure-Go INT8 PulseNet-RF; rescue distorted captures with 3-pass OOK + 1D-UNet AGC denoising; decode fixed/rolling codes, TPMS and weather sensors; run Foxhunt Geiger mode, RAW Trimmer, Auto-Probe, DB sync, and an opt-in stdio MCP server.
